attributes.name: ypy-head
attributes.description: On the `<head>` of a response, chooses how the head is merged into the page. On an element of the current `<head>`, `re-eval` removes and appends it again on every response so scripts run again.

values.name: merge
values.description: Make the page head equal to the response head: remove what the response lacks, add what is new. The default when the target is `body`.

values.name: append
values.description: Only add new head elements and keep the old ones. The default when the target is not `body`.

values.name: re-eval
values.description: On a head element: remove it and append it again on every response.

events.name: ypy:head:before:merge
events.description: Fires on `document.body` before the head of a response is merged. Cancel it to skip the merge. The detail is the one of `ypy:before:response`.

events.name: ypy:head:before:add
events.description: Fires before a new element is appended to `<head>`. Cancel it to leave that element out.

events.name: ypy:head:before:remove
events.description: Fires before an element is removed from `<head>`. Cancel it to keep that element.

events.name: ypy:head:after:merge
events.description: Fires after the head was merged, with the elements that were added, kept and removed.
